sections.title: Session readiness
sections.sql: select programme, session, starts_at, booked, waiting, capacity from session_readiness order by starts_at

sections.title: Staff coverage
sections.sql: select session,staff_count,children_per_staff,first_aiders from session_readiness where status='scheduled' order by starts_at
sections.note: Each roster entry means full-session coverage. Times shown are UTC.

sections.title: Collection and attendance
sections.sql: select session,child,attendance_state,signed_in_at,signed_out_at from daily_roll order by starts_at,child

sections.title: Outstanding invoices
sections.sql: select family,currency,balance_cents,overdue_cents,earliest_due from family_balances order by overdue_cents desc
